findings.description: The plate reads 'STE 097' at 0:00 (sharpest frame) but appears as 'STE 197' at 0:02 — the second digit changed from a wide oval '0' to a narrow '1'. No visible action (plate swap, occlusion, tampering) explains the change; the plate is only partially cropped at the frame bottom and lightly motion-smeared, but the digit shape difference exceeds what blur would produce.
